purpose: Add an app-owned ACM supplement zip inspector that emits normalized Goal5329 intake JSON if an ACM-access reviewer obtains ics26-106.zip.

inspector.input: local zip file obtained by owner or ACM-access reviewer
heuristics: dataset/hash-like entries by dataset suffixes, archive suffixes, hash tokens, or dataset tokens
script/instruction-like entries by script suffixes or README/artifact/reproduce/download tokens

behavior_locked_by_tests: camera-ready-only synthetic zip emits no-artifact ACM listing and validator keeps blocked
artifact-bearing synthetic zip emits dataset/hash and script entries, validator records ACM inspected with ingest-before-POD action
Goal5333 planner maps artifact-bearing ACM case to separate acm_artifact_instruction_ingestion_gate with pod_allowed_next=false
invalid zip fails without output claim

pod_usage.reason: Local zip inspection and intake JSON generation only. POD is used only after a later artifact-instruction ingestion goal justifies it.

allowed_summary: Goal5335 adds an app-owned local inspector for a future ACM supplement zip. It can generate normalized intake JSON for the existing validator/ingest/planner chain.
not_allowed: claiming the real ACM supplement has been inspected from synthetic tests
claiming the real ACM supplement contains datasets
claiming the real ACM supplement contains no useful artifacts
